questions.text: Which of the following models of attention suggests that information is filtered out after some semantic processing has occurred, rather than being blocked entirely at the sensory level?

options.description: Suggests early selection based on physical characteristics.
Proposes that all stimuli are processed for meaning before selection.
Unattended info is turned down like a volume knob, not cut off.
Focuses on cognitive resources rather than structural filters.

questions.text: Explain the difference between short-term and working memory from a neurobiological perspective. Provide examples of brain regions involved.
